 ATP Vienna Best Bets Including Tomas Machac Vs Alex De Minaur 
 Share Share this article
 × X Facebook LinkedIn WhatsApp Reddit Email Copy 
 The ATP Vienna tournament begins in Austria. This is a 500-point tournament which is held during the same week as the other ATP 500-point event in Basel. The focus for some of the players in Vienna is the ATP race to Turin. A semifinal, final, or title before next week’s 1,000-point Paris Masters would be very helpful for the players near the cut line. The ATP Finals obviously includes the top eight players in the ATP race for the calendar year’s full tennis season, but with Jannik Sinner being out for the rest of 2026 with an injury, the ninth spot in the race will earn a ticket to Italy for the year-end championship. Now we get to see if one of the race contenders can add hundreds of points at this 2026 ATP Vienna event, or if someone who is lower in the race standings will make a big run and walk away with an unexpected trophy before the tennis season concludes. LWOS has our best bets for three matches. Post your best bets and thoughts in the comments.
 ATP Vienna 
 Matteo Berrettini – Tomas Martin Etcheverry: 7:30 EST 
 H2H: 0-0 
 This ATP Vienna match discussion begins with the fact that Tomas Martin Etcheverry has lost five matches in a row. Matteo Berrettini is a sportsbook favorite at 1.57 because Etcheverry has been very poor the past few weeks. Can Etcheverry turn his season around before it ends?
 Best Bet to Make 
 Welcome to our best bet section. You’re going to get a collection of bets to consider, also a confidence level which should guide how much you should invest in this match. 
 Parlay/hedge options: Etcheverry +1.5 sets at 1.60 at @betway 
 Confidence level on a scale of 1-10: 4 – You should not bet more than half a unit on this match.  
 This ATP Vienna match is tricky in that Etcheverry might be due for a good performance, so don’t bet too much here. However, it’s really hard to make a pro-Etcheverry bet. Go with Berrettini on the game spread.
 That being said, betting on Berrettini -1.5 games is the best bet you can make 
 Value bet/ the best odds: Berrettini -1.5 games at 1.74 at @betfair 
 Tomas Machac – Alex De Minaur: 9:00 EST 
 H2H: 1-2 
 This ATP Vienna match involves two players who are both 3-2 in their last five matches. Let’s see if Tomas Machac, priced as the clear underdog, is being undervalued against Alex De Minaur. We know De Minaur hasn’t had a great season, but he hasn’t been quite as bad in the fall season as he was this past summer.
 Mar 12, 2022; Indian Wells, CA, USA; Tomas Machac (CZE) hits a shot in his 2nd round match against Daniil Medvedev (RUS) at the BNP Paribas open at the Indian Wells Tennis Garden. Mandatory Credit: Jayne Kamin-Oncea-USA TODAY Sports | Source: Lastwordonsports.com - Yesh Ginsburg 
 Best Bet to Make 
 Parlay/hedge options: Machac +1.5 sets at 2.04 at @unibet 
 Confidence level on a scale of 1-10: 1 – you should not bet on this match. 
 This ATP Vienna match is an awful match to bet on. The prices for the various spreads just don’t work. The return on investment combined with the likelihood of winning just doesn’t feel right in a lot of spots. If you insist on a bet, it’s De Minaur -3.5 games.
 That being said, betting on De Minaur -3.5 games is the best bet you can make 
 Value bet/ the best odds: De Minaur -3.5 games at 1.66 at @1xbet 
 Jakub Mensik – Lukas Neumayer: 11:30 EST 
 H2H: 0-0 
 This ATP Vienna match appears lopsided on paper. Jakub Mensik is a top-20 player. Lukas Neumayer is outside the top 150. Mensik -1.5 sets is priced at 1.49, which is not great value. This is a game spread match.
 Best Bet to Make 
 Parlay/hedge options: none 
 Confidence level on a scale of 1-10: 4 – you should not bet more than half a unit on this match. 
 This ATP Vienna match is all Mensik, but the game spread is large enough to make us not want to bet too much. Keep it a modest wager here.
 That being said, betting on Mensik -4.5 games is the best bet you can make 
 Value bet/ the best odds: Mensik -4.5 games at 1.83 @1xbet
